name: 一日の気分と実践の見出し
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: LH13-0013「一日の気分と実践の見出し」, ONE centered Japanese daily reflection header card.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image1 ORIGINAL Finch screenshot controls face/artwork geometry, proportions, optical weight, alignment, spacing and fine details; use ONLY its centered6AM face/date/quote area. Image2 ORIGINAL flat yellow face crop is highest authority for that drawing. Image3 FigCraft mock is SECONDARY Japanese content/type guide; it reverses time/face order and substitutes a different quote. Restore original time-above-face order and original quote meaning in Japanese. Image4 approved Lighthouse bus is STYLE ONLY for white card, fine neutral outline and restrained downward shadow.
Composition: one compact white rounded card on pure white canvas. Vertically centered stack: small time「午前6時」at top, original flat yellow happy face below, date line「8月27日 水曜日」below face, then two centered quotation lines. Keep meaningful hierarchy and compact spacing, full card visible with modest margin. No charts, habits, top Insights banner, navigation, action buttons, extra icons or text.
Exact copy:
「午前6時」
「8月27日 水曜日」
quote line1「夢を描くことは、」
quote line2「行動で裏付けなければならない。」
Quote faithfully translates source The dreaming has to be backed up by the doing; do not use the mock's unrelated 小さな一歩 wording.
Typography locked: Meiryo Regular12px/16px time, Bold20px/28px date line, Regular14px/24px quote, tracking0. Date in dark ink#1D1D1D; time/quote#6E6E6E with legible contrast. Preserve these roles, no serif or all-bold copy.
Face artwork: retain EXACT original matte flat yellow disk, two small brown oval eyes and simple brown curved smile. No eyebrows, cheeks, 3D shading, gloss, rim, generic emoji substitution or added facial details. Original yellow/brown colors are artwork only; no new accent is needed.
White surfaces, subtle neutral border, quiet24px corners, soft downward shadow. No mint fills, decorative green, gradients in background, glow, extra wrapper or device frame. Logical390x190 proportion, no clipping. Static raster design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画/平面的な黄の表情クロップ/モックを実見。原画を図像/順序/間隔の主参照にして午前6時を表情より上に戻し、原画の引用の意味を日本語へ忠実に復元。図像色以外のアクセント不要。結果実見:午前6時・黄の単純な目と口・8月27日水曜日・引用2行・白面・階層・見切れなしを確認。厳密な原画ピクセルとMeiryo実体は未証明。reviewedは画像候補のエージェント視覚レビューで所有者承認/編集性/実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
